domain: Public Health Policy / Medical Ethics / Constitutional Law
topic_summary: Analysis of vaccine mandate policies as a contested kernel where different parties read the shared commitment to 'legitimate state health intervention' differently. Public-health-primary readings ground legitimacy in population-level harm reduction and treat refusal as imposing externalized risk. Bodily-autonomy-primary readings ground legitimacy in individual consent and treat mandates as coercive state intrusion into medical decisions.

key_entities: State public health authority (mandate-issuing entity with police power)
Healthcare institutions (enforcement sites and professional norm-setters)
Vaccine efficacy data (contested observable for transmission reduction claims)
Constitutional bodily integrity doctrine (legal framework for autonomy claims)
key_tensions: Population-level harm reduction vs individual medical autonomy (state authority vs personal sovereignty)
Externality internalization vs coercion prohibition (public health rationale vs consent requirement)

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The shared commitment that state health intervention must be legitimate, with legitimacy grounded in either population-level harm reduction (public health reading) or individual consent preservation (autonomy reading)
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Public health agencies claim interpretive authority via epidemiological expertise; civil liberties frameworks claim authority via constitutional precedent and consent doctrine

readings.commitment: Legitimacy derives from measurable reduction in population-level morbidity/mortality; individual refusal is externality imposition
readings.authority_grounding: Epidemiological expertise; Jacobson v Massachusetts precedent (state police power for communicable disease)
readings.expected_structural_delta: Unvaccinated enter victim set as disease vectors; immunocompromised are beneficiaries; high ε from enforcement mechanisms (employment termination, access restrictions)

readings.commitment: Legitimacy requires informed consent for medical interventions; state coercion violates bodily integrity regardless of public benefit
readings.authority_grounding: Constitutional privacy doctrine; Nuremberg Code; medical ethics consent framework
readings.expected_structural_delta: Mandate-coerced individuals enter victim set; state becomes extractor via employment/access leverage; moderate-to-high ε depending on enforcement severity

readings.commitment: Legitimacy requires proportionality between intervention severity and threat level; both population harm and individual autonomy matter but are weighted by disease characteristics
readings.authority_grounding: European Court of Human Rights proportionality doctrine; Canadian Oakes test; harm principle balancing
readings.expected_structural_delta: Victim set varies by disease severity (measles vs flu); ε scales with transmissibility and case-fatality rate; introduces conditional constraint structure

axes.human_readable: Public Health Primary Reading (Population Harm Reduction as Legitimacy Ground)
axes.structural_delta: State authority to mandate vaccination derives from measurable reduction in population morbidity/mortality; individual refusal treated as externality imposition on vulnerable populations
axes.primary_observable: Transmission reduction rates; hospitalization/mortality differentials between vaccinated and unvaccinated cohorts; immunocompromised exposure risk
axes.selection_reason: First reading of contested kernel; distinct victim set and beneficiary structure from sibling readings

axes.human_readable: Bodily Autonomy Primary Reading (Consent as Legitimacy Ground)
axes.structural_delta: State authority to mandate medical interventions requires informed consent; coercion via employment/access restrictions violates bodily integrity regardless of population benefit
axes.primary_observable: Enforcement mechanism severity (job loss, institutional exclusion); consent framework violations; constitutional privacy doctrine precedents
axes.selection_reason: Second reading of contested kernel; inverts victim/beneficiary structure from public_health_primary

axes.structural_delta: Mandate legitimacy scales with disease severity and transmissibility; both population harm and individual autonomy are weighted by epidemiological characteristics
axes.primary_observable: Case-fatality rate; R0 (basic reproduction number); vaccine efficacy against transmission; availability of less-restrictive alternatives
axes.selection_reason: Third reading of contested kernel; introduces conditional constraint structure that neither polar reading captures

axes.human_readable: Institutional Capture (Healthcare System as Enforcement Proxy)
axes.structural_delta: Healthcare institutions become state enforcement proxies for mandates, creating professional norm conflicts and liability transfer
axes.primary_observable: Hospital/clinic mandate adoption rates; professional association policy statements; liability insurance requirements
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: enforcement mechanism detail downstream of public_health_primary reading; lower structural distinctiveness

axes.human_readable: Efficacy Contestation (Transmission Reduction as Disputed Observable)
axes.structural_delta: Vaccine efficacy against transmission becomes contested observable, undermining externality rationale for mandates
axes.primary_observable: Breakthrough infection rates; viral load comparisons; duration of protection; variant-specific efficacy data
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: upstream mountain but captured within proportionality_reading's conditional structure; would require separate generation only if efficacy data were uncontested

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Healthcare institutions as state enforcement proxies
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Enforcement mechanism detail downstream of public_health_primary; lower structural distinctiveness than kernel readings

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Vaccine transmission reduction as contested observable
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Upstream mountain captured within proportionality_reading's conditional structure; efficacy data contestation is the mechanism by which proportionality assessment varies

omegas.description: Does prior infection confer equivalent protection to vaccination? If yes, mandate legitimacy under public_health_primary reading weakens (externality rationale collapses). If no, bodily_autonomy_primary reading must address why natural immunity holders are coerced.

Vaccine manufacturers hold liability immunity under PREP Act. Does this asymmetry (state mandates product, manufacturer bears no liability for adverse events) constitute a Snare where the unvaccinated subsidize manufacturer risk externalization?

If vaccine efficacy wanes over 6-12 months, does the mandate become a Piton (recurring coercion cycle) rather than a one-time Rope (coordination mechanism)? Proportionality_reading may reclassify based on booster frequency.

If transmission reduction is negligible (efficacy_contestation resolves against public health claims), public_health_primary and proportionality_reading collapse into bodily_autonomy_primary. Externality rationale disappears; only coercion remains.

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Kernel structure confirmed: three readings emit structurally distinct constraints with different victim sets (unvaccinated-coerced vs immunocompromised-exposed vs conditional-on-threat-level). Efficacy_contestation deferred because it is the mechanism by which proportionality_reading's conditional structure operates, not a separate axis.
